table.retrieve:
SELECT
	SummaryAccCode=S.SummaryAccCode,
	SummaryAccount=S.SummaryAccount,
	SummaryAccountAlias=S.SummaryAccountAlias,
	DocumentCode=P.PurInvCode,
	SuppInvCode=P.SuppInvCode,
	SuppInvDate=P.SuppInvDate,
	GRN=P.GRN,
	Type='PV-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), P.PurInvCode))),
	Date = P.Date, 
	Remark = ISNULL(MAX(D.ItemDescription), (SELECT I.NAME FROM Item I WHERE I.ICODE = D.ICode)),
	Name=S.Name,
	Cash = CASE P.PurCatCode WHEN 1 THEN 'Y' WHEN 7 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,
	S.AliasName,
	S.OpenBalance,
	CheckNo=NULL,
	VRow=MAX(D.PurRowID),
	VoucherCode=P.HeaderInvNo,
	Header=P.HeaderNo,
	Qty=SUM(D.LooseQty+PackQty),
	Bonus=SUM(D.BonusQty),
	Rate=MAX(D.PurPrice),
	GrossValue=SUM((D.LooseQty + D.PackQty) * D.PurPrice),
	Discount=
		SUM((D.looseqty+D.PackQty) * D.Purprice * (.01 * D.discperc)) + 
		SUM((D.looseqty+D.PackQty) * D.Purprice * (1-(.01*D.discperc)) * (.01 * P.discperc)),
	ItemSaleTax=SUM( (D.PackQty + D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.UnitSalesTax) + 
		SUM(((D.PackQty + D.looseqty) * D.Purprice) * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01),
	ItemValue=SUM((D.PackQty + D.LooseQty) * D.PurPrice) - 
		SUM((D.looseqty + D.PackQty) * D.Purprice * (.01 * D.discperc) +
				((D.looseqty + D.PackQty) * D.Purprice * (1-(.01*D.discperc)) * (.01 * P.discperc))) +  
		SUM( (D.PackQty + D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.UnitSalesTax) + 
		SUM( (D.PackQty + D.looseqty) * D.Purprice * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01),
/*	MiscCharges=P.MiscCharges,
	FlatDisc=P.FlatDisc,
	InvSaleTax=T.InvSaleTax,
	RoundingDiff=T.RoundingDiff,*/
	NetAmt=T.NetAmt,
	Debit = CASE MAX(D.PurRowID) WHEN (SELECT MAX(PD.PurROWID) 
		FROM PurDetail PD 
		WHERE PD.PurInvCode=P.PurInvCode) THEN CASE P.PurCatCode WHEN 1 THEN T.NetAmt WHEN 7 THEN T.NetAmt ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END,
	Credit= CASE MAX(D.PurRowID) WHEN (SELECT MAX(PD.PurROWID) 
		FROM PurDetail PD 
		WHERE PD.PurInvCode=P.PurInvCode) THEN T.NetAmt ELSE 0 END,
	Others= CASE MAX(D.PurRowID) WHEN (SELECT MAX(PD.PurROWID) 
		FROM PurDetail PD 
		WHERE PD.PurInvCode=P.PurInvCode) THEN ISNULL(P.MiscCharges, 0) - ISNULL(P.FlatDisc, 0) + ISNULL(T.InvSaleTax, 0) + ISNULL(T.RoundingDiff, 0) ELSE 0 END
FROM
	(SELECT	A.AliasName, A.AccCode, A.Name, 
			SummaryAccount=SA.Name, SummaryAccountAlias=SA.AliasName, SA.SummaryAccCode,
			OpenBalance=ISNULL(
				(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(VG.Debit - VG.Credit), 0) 
				FROM 
					(SELECT SDD.AccCode FROM SummaryAccountDetail SDD 
					WHERE SDD.SummaryAccCode = SA.SummaryAccCode) A, VirtualGL VG
				WHERE VG.AccCode=A.AccCode AND VG.date < :ar_startdate), 0)
	FROM	Accounts A, SummaryAccount SA, SummaryAccountDetail SAD
	WHERE	SA.SummaryAccCode IN (:ar_summacccode) AND
			SA.SummaryAccCode = SAD.SummaryAccCode AND
			SAD.AccCode = A.AccCode) S, PurLedger P, PurDetail D,
	(SELECT 
		P.PurInvCode, 
		RoundingDiff=
		ROUND(
			SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty + D.bonusqty) *
				D.unitsalestax) +
			SUM(ROUND((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice * 
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND((SUM(((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice) * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * P.discperc)) - P.flatdisc) * (P.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
			ROUND(SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * P.discperc)) + P.misccharges + P.salestax - P.flatdisc, 0) -
		(SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) +
		SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01) +
			ROUND( (SUM(((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.Purprice) *
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * P.Discperc)) -
				P.flatdisc) * (P.invgstperc1 * .01), 2) + 
		SUM( ((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.Purprice) * 
				 (1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * P.discperc)) + 
			P.misccharges + P.salestax - P.flatdisc),
		InvSaleTax=ROUND(SUM((D.PackQty + D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.UnitSalesTax) + 
		SUM(((D.PackQty + D.looseqty) * D.Purprice) * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01), 2),
		NetAmt=ROUND(
			SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty + D.bonusqty) *
				D.unitsalestax) +
			SUM(ROUND((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice * 
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND((SUM(((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice) * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * P.discperc)) - P.flatdisc) * (P.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
			ROUND(SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * P.discperc)) + P.misccharges + P.salestax - P.flatdisc, 0)
	FROM 
		(SELECT	A.AccCode
		FROM	Accounts A, SummaryAccount SA, SummaryAccountDetail SAD
		WHERE	SA.SummaryAccCode IN (:ar_summacccode) AND
				SA.SummaryAccCode = SAD.SummaryAccCode AND
				SAD.AccCode = A.AccCode) S, PurLedger P, PurDetail D
	WHERE 
		P.Posted = 'Y' AND P.AccountFor = 'Y' AND
		P.PurInvCode = D.PurInvCode AND
		P.SuppCode = S.AccCode AND
		P.date     >= :ar_startdate AND
		P.date     <= :ar_enddate
	GROUP BY
		P.PurInvCode,
		P.DiscPerc,
		P.FlatDisc,
		P.InvGSTPerc1,
		P.DiscPerc,
		P.MiscCharges,
		P.SalesTax) T
WHERE   
	P.Posted = 'Y' AND P.AccountFor = 'Y' AND
	P.PurInvCode = D.PurInvCode AND P.PurInvCode = T.PurInvCode AND
	P.SuppCode = S.AccCode AND
	P.date     >= :ar_startdate AND
	P.date     <= :ar_enddate
GROUP BY 
	S.SummaryAccCode,
	S.SummaryAccount,
	S.SummaryAccountAlias,
	S.OpenBalance,
	P.PurInvCode,
	P.PurCatCode,
	P.HeaderInvNo,
	P.HeaderNo,
	D.ICode,
	P.SuppCode, 
	P.Date,
	P.DiscPerc,
	P.MiscCharges,
	P.SalesTax,
	P.FlatDisc,
	P.InvGstPerc1,
	P.SuppInvCode,
	P.SuppInvDate,
	P.GRN,
	S.AccCode,
	S.AliasName,
	S.Name,
	T.InvSaleTax,
	T.NetAmt,
	T.RoundingDiff
UNION ALL
SELECT  
	S.SummaryAccCode,
	S.SummaryAccount,
	S.SummaryAccountAlias,
	DocumentCode=P.PurInvCode,
	SuppInvCode=P.SuppInvCode,
	SuppInvDate=P.SuppInvDate,
	GRN=P.GRN,
	Type='PV-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), P.PurInvCode))),
	Date = P.AmtDate, 
	Remark = 'Cash Paid During Pur #:' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), P.PurInvCode))),
	Name=S.Name,
	Cash = CASE P.PurCatCode WHEN 1 THEN 'Y' WHEN 7 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,
	S.AliasName,
	S.OpenBalance,
	CheckNo=P.AmtReference,
	VRow=9999999,
	VoucherCode=P.HeaderInvNo,
	Header=P.HeaderNo,
	Qty=0,
	Bonus=0,
	Rate=0,
	GrossValue=0,
	Discount=0,
	ItemSaleTax=0,
	ItemValue=0,
/*	MiscCharges=P.MiscCharges,
	FlatDisc=P.FlatDisc,
	InvSaleTax=T.InvSaleTax,
	RoundingDiff=T.RoundingDiff,*/
	NetAmt=0,
	Debit = P.Amt,
	Credit= 0,
	Others= 0
FROM
	(SELECT	A.AliasName, A.AccCode, A.Name, 
			SummaryAccount=SA.Name, SummaryAccountAlias=SA.AliasName, SA.SummaryAccCode,
			OpenBalance=ISNULL(
				(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(VG.Debit - VG.Credit), 0) 
				FROM 
					(SELECT SDD.AccCode FROM SummaryAccountDetail SDD 
					WHERE SDD.SummaryAccCode = SA.SummaryAccCode) A, VirtualGL VG
				WHERE VG.AccCode=A.AccCode AND VG.date < :ar_startdate), 0)
	FROM	Accounts A, SummaryAccount SA, SummaryAccountDetail SAD
	WHERE	SA.SummaryAccCode IN (:ar_summacccode) AND
			SA.SummaryAccCode = SAD.SummaryAccCode AND
			SAD.AccCode = A.AccCode) S,	PurLedger P
WHERE   
	P.Posted = 'Y' AND P.AccountFor = 'Y' AND
	P.SuppCode = S.AccCode AND
	P.Amtdate     >= :ar_startdate AND
	P.Amtdate     <= :ar_enddate AND
	P.Amt <> 0 AND P.PurCatcode NOT IN (1,7)
UNION ALL
SELECT  
	SummaryAccCode=S.SummaryAccCode,
	SummaryAccount=S.SummaryAccount,
	SummaryAccountAlias=S.SummaryAccountAlias,
	DocumentCode=P.PrInvCode,
	SuppInvCode=NULL,
	SuppInvDate=NULL,
	GRN=NULL,
	Type='PR-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), P.PrInvCode))),
	Date = P.Date, 
	Remark = ISNULL(MAX(D.ItemDescription), (SELECT I.NAME FROM Item I WHERE I.ICODE = D.ICode)),
	Name=S.Name,
	Cash = CASE P.PrCatCode WHEN 4 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,
	S.AliasName,
	S.OpenBalance,
	CheckNo=NULL,
	VRow=MAX(D.PRUTN),
	VoucherCode=P.HeaderInvNo,
	Header=P.HeaderNo,
	Qty=-SUM(D.LooseQty+PackQty),
	Bonus=-SUM(D.BonusQty),
	Rate=MAX(D.PrPrice),
	GrossValue=-SUM((D.LooseQty + D.PackQty) * D.PRPrice),
	Discount= -1 *
		(SUM((D.looseqty+D.PackQty) * D.Prprice * (.01 * D.discperc)) + 
		SUM((D.looseqty+D.PackQty) * D.Prprice * (1-(.01*D.discperc)) * (.01 * P.discperc))),
	ItemSaleTax= -1 * (SUM( (D.PackQty + D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.UnitSalesTax) + 
		SUM(((D.PackQty + D.looseqty) * D.Prprice) * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01)),
	ItemValue= -1 * (SUM((D.PackQty + D.LooseQty) * D.PrPrice) - 
		SUM((D.looseqty + D.PackQty) * D.Prprice * (.01 * D.discperc) +
				((D.looseqty + D.PackQty) * D.Prprice * (1-(.01*D.discperc)) * (.01 * P.discperc))) +  
		SUM( (D.PackQty + D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.UnitSalesTax) + 
		SUM( (D.PackQty + D.looseqty) * D.Prprice * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01)),
	NetAmt=T.NetAmt,
	Debit = CASE MAX(D.PRUTN) WHEN (SELECT MAX(PD.PRUTN) 
		FROM PrDetail PD 
		WHERE PD.PrInvCode=P.PrInvCode) THEN T.NetAmt ELSE 0 END,
	Credit= CASE MAX(D.PRUTN) WHEN (SELECT MAX(PD.PRUTN) 
		FROM PrDetail PD 
		WHERE PD.PrInvCode=P.PrInvCode) THEN CASE P.PrCatCode WHEN 4 THEN T.NetAmt ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END,
	Others= CASE MAX(D.PRUTN) WHEN (SELECT MAX(PD.PRUTN) 
		FROM PrDetail PD 
		WHERE PD.PrInvCode=P.PrInvCode) THEN ISNULL(P.MiscCharges, 0) - ISNULL(P.FlatDisc, 0) + ISNULL(T.InvSaleTax, 0) + ISNULL(T.RoundingDiff, 0) ELSE 0 END
FROM
	(SELECT	A.AliasName, A.AccCode, A.Name, 
			SummaryAccount=SA.Name, SummaryAccountAlias=SA.AliasName, SA.SummaryAccCode,
			OpenBalance=ISNULL(
				(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(VG.Debit - VG.Credit), 0) 
				FROM 
					(SELECT SDD.AccCode FROM SummaryAccountDetail SDD 
					WHERE SDD.SummaryAccCode = SA.SummaryAccCode) A, VirtualGL VG
				WHERE VG.AccCode=A.AccCode AND VG.date < :ar_startdate), 0)
	FROM	Accounts A, SummaryAccount SA, SummaryAccountDetail SAD
	WHERE	SA.SummaryAccCode IN (:ar_summacccode) AND
			SA.SummaryAccCode = SAD.SummaryAccCode AND
			SAD.AccCode = A.AccCode) S, PrLedger P, PrDetail D,
	(SELECT 
		P.PrInvCode, 
		RoundingDiff=
		ROUND(
			SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty + D.bonusqty) *
				D.unitsalestax) +
			SUM(ROUND((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.prprice * 
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND((SUM(((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.prprice) * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * P.discperc)) - P.flatdisc) * (P.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
			ROUND(SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.prprice * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * P.discperc)) + P.misccharges + P.salestax - P.flatdisc, 0) -
		(SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) +
		SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.prprice * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01) +
			ROUND( (SUM(((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.Prprice) *
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * P.Discperc)) -
				P.flatdisc) * (P.invgstperc1 * .01), 2) + 
		SUM( ((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.Prprice) * 
				 (1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * P.discperc)) + 
			P.misccharges + P.salestax - P.flatdisc),
		InvSaleTax=ROUND(SUM((D.PackQty + D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.UnitSalesTax) + 
		SUM(((D.PackQty + D.looseqty) * D.Prprice) * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01), 2),
		NetAmt=ROUND(
			SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty + D.bonusqty) *
				D.unitsalestax) +
			SUM(ROUND((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.prprice * 
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND((SUM(((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.prprice) * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * P.discperc)) - P.flatdisc) * (P.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
			ROUND(SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.prprice * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * P.discperc)) + P.misccharges + P.salestax - P.flatdisc, 0)
	FROM 
		(SELECT	A.AccCode
		FROM	Accounts A, SummaryAccount SA, SummaryAccountDetail SAD
		WHERE	SA.SummaryAccCode IN (:ar_summacccode) AND
				SA.SummaryAccCode = SAD.SummaryAccCode AND
				SAD.AccCode = A.AccCode) S, PrLedger P, PrDetail D
	WHERE 
		P.Posted = 'Y' AND P.AccountFor = 'Y' AND
		P.PrInvCode = D.PrInvCode AND
		P.SuppCode = S.AccCode AND
		P.date     >= :ar_startdate AND
		P.date     <= :ar_enddate
	GROUP BY
		P.PrInvCode,
		P.DiscPerc,
		P.FlatDisc,
		P.InvGSTPerc1,
		P.DiscPerc,
		P.MiscCharges,
		P.SalesTax) T
WHERE   
	P.Posted = 'Y' AND P.AccountFor = 'Y' AND
	P.PrInvCode = D.PrInvCode AND P.PrInvCode = T.PrInvCode AND
	P.SuppCode = S.AccCode AND
	P.date     >= :ar_startdate AND
	P.date     <= :ar_enddate
GROUP BY 
	S.SummaryAccCode,
	S.SummaryAccount,
	S.SummaryAccountAlias,
	S.OpenBalance,
	P.PrInvCode,
	P.PrCatCode,
	P.HeaderInvNo,
	P.HeaderNo,
	D.ICode,
	P.SuppCode, 
	P.Date,
	P.DiscPerc,
	P.MiscCharges,
	P.SalesTax,
	P.FlatDisc,
	P.InvGstPerc1,
	S.AccCode,
	S.AliasName,
	S.Name,
	T.InvSaleTax,
	T.NetAmt,
	T.RoundingDiff
UNION ALL
SELECT  
	SummaryAccCode=S.SummaryAccCode,
	SummaryAccount=S.SummaryAccount,
	SummaryAccountAlias=S.SummaryAccountAlias,
	DocumentCode=P.PrInvCode,
	SuppInvCode=NULL,
	SuppInvDate=NULL,
	GRN=NULL,
	Type='PR-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), P.PrInvCode))),
	Date = P.AmtDate, 
	Remark = 'Cash Recvd. During P/Ret #:' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), P.PrInvCode))),
	Name=S.Name,
	Cash = CASE P.PrCatCode WHEN 4 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,
	S.AliasName,
	S.OpenBalance,
	CheckNo=P.AmtReference,
	VRow=9999999,
	VoucherCode=P.HeaderInvNo,
	Header=P.HeaderNo,
	Qty=0,
	Bonus=0,
	Rate=0,
	GrossValue=0,
	Discount=0,
	ItemSaleTax=0,
	ItemValue=0,
/*	MiscCharges=P.MiscCharges,
	FlatDisc=P.FlatDisc,
	InvSaleTax=T.InvSaleTax,
	RoundingDiff=T.RoundingDiff,*/
	NetAmt=0,
	Debit = 0,
	Credit= P.Amt,
	Others= 0
FROM
	(SELECT	A.AliasName, A.AccCode, A.Name, 
			SummaryAccount=SA.Name, SummaryAccountAlias=SA.AliasName, SA.SummaryAccCode,
			OpenBalance=ISNULL(
				(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(VG.Debit - VG.Credit), 0) 
				FROM 
					(SELECT SDD.AccCode FROM SummaryAccountDetail SDD 
					WHERE SDD.SummaryAccCode = SA.SummaryAccCode) A, VirtualGL VG
				WHERE VG.AccCode=A.AccCode AND VG.date < :ar_startdate), 0)
	FROM	Accounts A, SummaryAccount SA, SummaryAccountDetail SAD
	WHERE	SA.SummaryAccCode IN (:ar_summacccode) AND
			SA.SummaryAccCode = SAD.SummaryAccCode AND
			SAD.AccCode = A.AccCode) S, PrLedger P
WHERE   
	P.Posted = 'Y' AND P.AccountFor = 'Y' AND
	P.SuppCode = S.AccCode AND
	P.Amtdate     >= :ar_startdate AND
	P.Amtdate     <= :ar_enddate AND
	P.Amt <> 0 AND P.PrCatcode NOT IN (4)
UNION ALL
SELECT  
	SummaryAccCode=C.SummaryAccCode,
	SummaryAccount=C.SummaryAccount,
	SummaryAccountAlias=C.SummaryAccountAlias,
	DocumentCode=S.SaleInvCode,
	SuppInvCode=NULL,
	SuppInvDate=NULL,
	GRN=NULL,
	Type='SV-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), S.SaleInvCode))),
	Date = S.Date, 
	Remark = ISNULL(MAX(D.SaleItemDescription) ,(SELECT I.NAME FROM Item I WHERE I.ICODE = D.ICode)),
	Name=c.Name,
	Cash = CASE S.SaleCatCode WHEN 2 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END,
	C.AliasName,
	C.OpenBalance,
	CheckNo=NULL,
	VRow=MAX(D.RowID),
	VoucherCode=S.HeaderInvNo,
	Header=S.HeaderNo,
	Qty=SUM(D.LooseQty),
	Bonus=SUM(D.BonusQty),
	Rate=MAX(D.SalePrice),
	GrossValue=SUM(D.LooseQty * D.SalePrice),
	Discount=
		SUM(D.looseqty*D.itemflatdisc) +
		SUM(D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc) * (.01 * D.discperc)) + 
		SUM(D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc) * 
			(1-(.01*D.discperc)) * (.01 * S.discperc)),
	ItemSaleTax=SUM( (D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) + 
		SUM((D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) *
			(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01),
	ItemValue=SUM(D.LooseQty * D.SalePrice) - 
		SUM((D.looseqty*D.itemflatdisc) +
				(D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc) * (.01 * D.discperc)) +
				(D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc) * (1-(.01*D.discperc)) * 
				(.01 * S.discperc))) + 
		SUM( (D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) + 
		SUM((D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) *
			(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01),
/*	MiscCharges=S.MiscCharges,
	FlatDisc=S.FlatDisc,
	InvSaleTax=T.InvSaleTax,
	RoundingDiff=T.RoundingDiff,*/
	NetAmt=T.NetAmt,
	Debit = CASE MAX(D.RowID) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.ROWID) 
		FROM SaleInvDetail SD 
		WHERE SD.SaleInvCode=S.SaleInvCode) THEN T.NetAmt ELSE 0 END,
	Credit= CASE MAX(D.RowID) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.ROWID) 
		FROM SaleInvDetail SD 
		WHERE SD.SaleInvCode=S.SaleInvCode) THEN CASE S.SaleCatCode WHEN 2 THEN 0 ELSE T.NetAmt END ELSE 0 END,
	Others= CASE MAX(D.RowID) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.ROWID) 
		FROM SaleInvDetail SD 
		WHERE SD.SaleInvCode=S.SaleInvCode) THEN ISNULL(S.MiscCharges, 0) - ISNULL(S.FlatDisc, 0) + ISNULL(T.InvSaleTax, 0) + ISNULL(T.RoundingDiff, 0) ELSE 0 END
FROM
	(SELECT	A.AliasName, A.AccCode, A.Name, 
			SummaryAccount=SA.Name, SummaryAccountAlias=SA.AliasName, SA.SummaryAccCode,
			OpenBalance=ISNULL(
				(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(VG.Debit - VG.Credit), 0) 
				FROM 
					(SELECT SDD.AccCode FROM SummaryAccountDetail SDD 
					WHERE SDD.SummaryAccCode = SA.SummaryAccCode) A, VirtualGL VG
				WHERE VG.AccCode=A.AccCode AND VG.date < :ar_startdate), 0)
	FROM	Accounts A, SummaryAccount SA, SummaryAccountDetail SAD
	WHERE	SA.SummaryAccCode IN (:ar_summacccode) AND
			SA.SummaryAccCode = SAD.SummaryAccCode AND

				WHERE VG.AccCode=A.AccCode AND VG.date < :ar_startdate), 0)

	WHERE	SA.SummaryAccCode IN (:ar_summacccode) AND
			SA.SummaryAccCode = SAD.SummaryAccCode AND
